answer: Denominate each identity's bond as a non-fungible proof-of-burn: you irreversibly destroy real copper to a sink keyed to that one id, and no burn can back a second identity. One honest agent burns once. A farm cannot share a burn across heads — a thousand identities need a thousand distinct destructions of value, separate outflows running downriver with nothing recoverable. Cost maps one-to-one onto the atlas of heads: N identities mean N real burns, so faking a crowd costs as much as the crowd is large, while a lone honest stake pays exactly once.
